title: Week 4 Update - From Above - New map, modular gear system, and he can swim now!
author: edm-4-life
selftext:
Quick update on progress. Each day is a learning experience. I know I learn so much from everyone's shared ideas, concepts, and community based workflows. Thank you all for sharing and sharing the knowledge. May 2nd zone/map is a lot of zero-asset workflow, which allows for more control on looks an interaction. As always, feedback welcome. It's been a busy last 2 weeks so progress hasn't been huge but there was a significant time spent on polishing up existing visuals, system, combat, and storyline.

Thanks for checking it out.

comments.author: Significant_Tell407
comments.body: What do you mean by zero asset workflow?

replies.author: edm-4-life
replies.body: It's drawn on the fly instead of importing 3d models - such as the houses, wall, and structures inside the new city. In Emberwood (the old/original town), the houses are all 3d models.

replies.author: Significant_Tell407
replies.body: How are you procedurally generating such detailed assets with only code?

replies.author: edm-4-life
replies.body:
[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=B0HN9kLxf7A&t=1s](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=B0HN9kLxf7A&t=1s)

I found this on another post on here. Literally fed its transcript to Claude and told it to do some deep research and give me some samples. Then, integrated it into the game. Pretty much what I meant when I said I learn new things everyday and thank our community for sharing.

replies.author: Significant_Tell407
replies.body: OOOh thanks for sharing the dark magic secrets

comments.author: Three_Tails_Studio
comments.body: FYI, your town of Emberwood needs a name change. "Ember" is the single most over used ai word next to Aether ... it just SCREAMS AI.

replies.author: edm-4-life
replies.body: lol I know. That was half of the comments on my last update. Only reason I kept it is because it means something else to me. Might change it soon tho lol

comments.author: karlpilkington4
comments.body: I like the style a lot. How did you do the combat systems and sword work?

replies.author: edm-4-life
replies.body: It took a lot of work to get it from primitive swings to this. It is a combination of Meshy pre-rigs and I also had Claude do some research on combat systems from existing games and other combat systems. It still needs some work but I'm happy with it for now.
